task.title: 移除或重置设置
task.shortdesc: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：移除或重置设置. Remove a configured value or reset it back to the inherited baseline, preset, or unconfigured state.

prereq.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：移除或重置设置. Open the setting detail panel for a configured value.

context.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：移除或重置设置. Remove and reset actions are destructive for the selected value, so the user should understand source and downstream effects first.

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：移除或重置设置. Inspect the current value and source badge.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：移除或重置设置. Choose Remove or Reset only for the setting you intend to change.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：移除或重置设置. Read any warning or validation message shown by the detail panel.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：移除或重置设置. Save the profile after confirming the value is absent, reset, or inherited as expected.

info.note: 警告：保存前请检查架构、值来源以及更改后果。

result.p: All Settings 显示配置文件的预期状态，并且该操作可在审查时解释。 The setting no longer applies from the previous configured value.

postreq.p: 恢复：如果结果不符合预期，请清除筛选器、返回详细信息面板或打开相关主题。 Recovery: if the removal was unintended, reapply the previous value from history, import, comparison, or a saved source document.
